Enum Class GameEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GameEvent>
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.GameEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<GameEvent>, Constable
public enum GameEvent extends Enum<GameEvent>
Discriminator for the events the model broadcasts through its observer channel. Listeners (views, network senders, persistence) subscribe to receive these and react accordingly. Values are grouped roughly by the phase that emits them:
  • lobby — LOBBY_STATE_SYNC, PLAYER_ADDED, GAME_STARTED,
  • per-turn — TOTEM_PLACED, TURN_CHANGED, STATE_CHANGED, CARD_PICKED, PLAYER_STATS_UPDATED, TOTEM_RESET, EVENT_RESOLVED,
  • round / era / game boundaries — ROUND_ENDED, ERA_CHANGED, GAME_ENDED,
  • connectivity — PLAYER_UPDATE, PLAYER_DISCONNECTED.
